about: The epistola of the formulary “17th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Brethren: I, a prisoner in the Lord, entreat you to walk worthily of the vocation with which you have been called, with complete humility and gentleness, with patience, supporting one another in love, eager to keep, through the bond of peace, the unity of the spirit. One body and one Spirit, just as you have been called in the one hope of your vocation. One Lord, one faith, one baptism. One God and Father of all, who is over all, and through all things, and in us all. He is blessed forever and ever. Amen.
